text: REQ-401 (2026-01-15, Growth, pricing): The Pro plan costs 12 per seat per month.
REQ-402 (2026-01-15, Growth, pricing): The Pro plan has a one-time onboarding fee of 150.
REQ-409 (2026-02-08, Growth, pricing): An account on the Pro plan is billed for at least 5 seats, even if it uses fewer.
REQ-415 (2026-03-03, Growth, pricing): Annual billing takes 15% off the Pro plan seat fees. The onboarding fee is never discounted.
REQ-422 (2026-04-01, Growth, pricing, replaces REQ-402): The Pro plan one-time onboarding fee is 200.
